findings: `learner.overview.text` conflates two separate claims by presenting the proposed 日+棗 structural analysis as the graph reused to write “morning/early.” Revise to distinguish that structural proposal from the separately documented use of 棗 to write the word 早, and describe the borrowing as proposed on sound resemblance rather than established for that analyzed graph.
